KITS-H1: Three kits for three starting points
KITS-HERO-SUB: We make brands impossible to ignore. A kit is for when you need several things done at once, all built on the same brand codes.
KITS-CARD-LAUNCH-FOR: Best for new or relaunching brands that need to look right and get moving.
KITS-CARD-LAUNCH-INC-3: A 30 to 60 day performance or social sprint
KITS-CARD-AUTH-FOR: Best for brands that want to be the name search engines and AI answers trust.
KITS-CARD-LOCAL-FOR: Best for clinics, trades, studios and venues that live on nearby customers.
KITS-CARD-LOCAL-INC-1: Google Business Profile and local SEO
KITS-CHOOSE-H2: Which kit is right for me?
KITS-CHOOSE-A: It depends on where you're starting. Launching or relaunching? The Launch Kit gives you a brand, a site and a sprint. Got a brand but can't be found? Try the Authority Kit. Living on nearby customers, like a clinic, trade or venue? That's the Local Domination Kit. Not sure? That's what the fit call is for.
KITS-ALACARTE-H2: Full package or à la carte
KITS-ALACARTE-A: Either works. Take Branding, SEO/AEO/GEO, Performance marketing or Social media on its own if you only need one thing. Pick a kit when you need several pieces built together on the same brand codes. We'll tell you honestly which makes sense at a short, no-pressure fit call.
KITS-FAQ-1-Q: Do the kits have fixed prices?
KITS-FAQ-1-A: No. There's no price list here, because every brand starts from a different place. We scope each kit after a short, no-pressure fit call, once we know your goals, your channels and where your brand feels stuck. You get a clear proposal before any work starts.
KITS-FAQ-2-Q: Can I buy just one service instead of a kit?
KITS-FAQ-2-A: Yes. Take any service on its own or combine them in a kit: Launch, Authority or Local Domination. Full package or à la carte, it all runs on the same brand codes. The fit call is where we work out what you need first.
KITS-FAQ-3-Q: Do the kits work outside the UK?
KITS-FAQ-3-A: Yes. We work with SMB founders and marketing leads right across the UK, Australia, Canada and Singapore. The work happens remotely, with calls always planned around your own time zone. We write in British English unless your market needs something else.
KITS-CTA-H2: Ready to be impossible to ignore?
KITS-CTA-BODY: Start with a short, no-pressure fit call. Tell us where your brand feels stuck. If we're not the right fit, we'll say so.
KITS-CTA-CHECK-BTN: Get a free AI visibility check
KITS-CTA-CHECK-NOTE: See what ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Gemini say about your brand today. We record exactly what we see and send your five most useful fixes within 3 working days. No guarantees, just a clear picture.
